knownFailureDisposition: Original approved detector mislabels some synthetic high notes by octave/subharmonic. Retained intentionally to preserve the owner-approved sound; snapped output frequencies in this same fixture passed. Agent must not treat note labels/MIDI or auto key estimates as ground truth.
